IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight light
brown hair walks down a bright hallway with a
glossy floor. She wears a fitted plum ribbed knit top
with a deep V neckline, layered with a pendant
necklace and a pearl choker. A lilac suede mini
skirt has a gold medallion belt, and she carries a
silver chainmail-style shoulder bag. Tall black knee
boots complete the look. Her expression is calm
and composed. Soft indoor light. Palette of plum,
lilac, and silver. Cozy and nostalgic, in the style of a
2000s film still.
